hero.headline: Cozy coworking space in Plovdiv for freelancers and remote workers

paragraphs: You come in with your laptop, tempted by our great prices, but you stay because something about the space just clicks.
It's warm. It's calm. It feels like people, not just desks.
Enjoy fast wifi, cozy corners, and a community-oriented coworking space right in the heart of Plovdiv.

It feels like a community, not just a coworking space. If you're looking for the best coworking experience in Plovdiv, this is it. Highly recommended!

community.heading: Find your people, not just a desk
paragraphs: At Raboteriya, you'll often meet freelancers, remote workers and small business owners - each with their own stories, ideas, skills and contacts. Sometimes the most helpful conversation of the day doesn't happen in a meeting. It starts casually, between two tasks, while making coffee in the kitchen.

That's why we make space for more than work. Every week, we gather for movie nights, board games, garden BBQs or simple evenings on the sofa after the laptops close. No forced networking. No corporate icebreakers. Just a place where people slowly become familiar - and where workdays feel a little less lonely.

faq.subheading: We know choosing a coworking space comes with questions. Here are the answers to the ones we're asked most often.

items.question: Do I need to book in advance?
items.answer: Yes - please do. Because we're a cozy, community-focused space, availability can be limited. Contact us at least one day in advance so we can make sure there's a spot waiting for you.

items.question: What's the parking situation like?
items.answer: Surprisingly easy. Even though we're in the city centre, Raboteriya is located in a residential area. All surrounding streets offer free parking, and there are usually plenty of spaces available.

items.question: Are there places to eat nearby?
items.answer: So many. Within a few minutes' walk you'll find:
list: Nolita - Bulgarian restaurant with affordable lunch menus
items.answerFooter: Mall Plovdiv and Sombrero Mexican Restaurant are also just a 10-minute walk away, so lunch options are never a problem.

items.question: How does entry to the space work?
items.answer: Once you become a member, we give you an access card - you simply tap your card and you're in. If it's your first visit, we'll be there to welcome you and show you around.

items.question: Can I visit the space before deciding?
items.answer: Of course. We're always happy to arrange viewings for individuals or small teams who want to see the space, feel the vibe, and decide if Raboteriya is right for them.

items.question: Do memberships come with contracts?
items.answer: No. All memberships are pay-as-you-go and paid month to month. We don't believe in locking people in - we'd rather you stay because you genuinely love working here.

items.question: Can the space be booked for events?
items.answer: Yes! Raboteriya can be booked for a variety of events. We've hosted team buildings, seminars, workshops, birthdays, and even small weddings of up to 40 people.

items.question: Is the space serviced?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our team takes care of keeping Raboteriya clean, tidy, and welcoming at all times - so you can simply come in, focus on your work, and enjoy the space.

items.question: Is Raboteriya pet-friendly?
items.answer: Absolutely. We love having furry friends around and you're more than welcome to bring your pet with you. We also recycle our plastic and donate the earnings to Animal Rescue Sofia - caring for animals is something we genuinely believe in. So yes, please do bring your furry companion along.

items.question: Do you have a static IP address?
items.answer: Yes - our WiFi comes with a static IP, so your work setup can stay nice and predictable.

items.question: Can I work with an additional screen?
items.answer: Yes. We have extra screens available at Raboteriya. Resident members get priority, but so far our Flex members and day pass visitors have always been able to use one too.

items.question: Can I register my company at Raboteriya's address?
items.answer: Yes - Raboteriya members can use our address as their official business address. It's a practical option if you don't want to register your company at home, or you need a stable place for business correspondence.

items.question: Is Raboteriya convenient if I live in Smirnenski or near Peshtersko Shose?
items.answer: Yes - Raboteriya is a homey coworking space close to the city centre, but also very convenient if you're coming from Hristo Smirnenski, Peshtersko Shose, or the western side of Plovdiv. You get an easy-to-reach workspace without having to cross the whole city.

items.question: Is Raboteriya easy to reach by train or bus?
items.answer: Yes - we're 10 minute walk from Plovdiv's Central Train Station and main bus station, which makes Raboteriya a convenient coworking space for people coming from another nearby town, or another city for the day.
